title: OK Progressions
description: Add Some QoL Block For Progressions
body:
**Required Dependencies:**
*   [ModularUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/modularui)
*   [GTNHLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/gtnhlib)
*   [OK Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/ok-core)
*   [UniMixins](https://modrinth.com/mod/unimixins)

## Features:
*   Cobblestone Generators.
*   Botany Pot.
*   Tiny Coal.
*   Growth Crystals.
*   Mycelium Seeds.
*   Emerald Apple.
*   Diamond Apple.
*   Charcoal Block.
*   Bone Block.
*   Flint Block.
*   Reinforced Obsidian.
*   Reinforced Glass.
*   Stone Stick And Torch.
*   Ender Ore And Dust.
*   Party Pickaxe.
*   Vanilla style Paxel.
